# MD033-fix: Inline HTML

Use <strong>bold</strong> and <em>emphasis</em> here.

Same with <b>bold</b> and <i>italic</i> tags.

Line one.<br>
Line two after br.

See <a href="https://example.com">example link</a> for more.

Unknown tag: <span class="note">wrapped in backticks</span> when quote_remaining is true.
